abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the expression of bcl-2, c-myc, c-fms and c-erbB-2 oncoproteins in normal placentas, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas and to examine the possible presence of mutations in the K-ras gene in complete moles and choriocarcinomas. STUDY DESIGN: The expression of the above oncoproteins was determined immunohistochemically by specific antibodies for these proteins on formalin-fixed paraffin sections of 18 normal placentas, 17 partial moles, 25 complete moles and 11 choriocarcinomas. This was followed by polymerase chain reaction analysis (exons 12 and 13) of K-ras gene for possible mutations in complete moles and choriocarcinomas. RESULTS: Expression of c-fms oncoprotein appeared confined to the cytoplasm of syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The c-fms protein staining intensity of the syncytiotrophoblastic layer showed no significant difference among the four gestational tissues. c-erbB-2 antibody expression was confined to the cellular membrane of the extravillous trophoblast. When compared with normal placenta or partial mole, the expression of c-erbB-2 protein was significantly stronger in complete mole (P < .0001 and P < .0001, respectively) and choriocarcinoma (P < .0001 and P < .0001, respectively). Expression of bcl-2 protein was significantly stronger in the syncytiotrophoblast in complete mole and choriocarcinoma as compared to both normal placenta and partial mole (P < .0001 and P < .0001, respectively). Staining of c-myc of the syncytiotrophoblastic layer was significantly stronger in placenta, complete mole and choriocarcinoma than in partial mole (P < .0001, P < .0001 and P < .0001, respectively). Mutation in K-ras gene was not found in any of the 22 complete moles or 11 choriocarcinomas examined. CONCLUSION: Our data suggest that c-myc, c-erbB-2, c-fms and bcl-2 oncoproteins may be important in the pathogenesis of complete mole and choriocarcinoma. However, while both complete mole and choriocarcinoma were characterized by overexpression of c-myc, c-erbB-2 and bcl-2, partial mole generally did not strongly express these three oncoproteins.
abstract_ja:
目的: 正常胎盤、部分および完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌において、bcl-2、c-myc、c-fms、c-erbB-2癌蛋白の発現を検討し、完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌におけるK-ras遺伝子の変異の有無を調べること。
研究デザイン: 正常胎盤18例、部分胞状奇胎17例、完全胞状奇胎25例、絨毛癌11例のホルマリン固定パラフィン切片を用い、上記癌蛋白の発現を特異抗体による免疫組織化学染色で検討した。続いて完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌について、K-ras遺伝子(エクソン12および13)のポリメラーゼ連鎖反応(PCR)解析を行い、変異の有無を検索した。
結果: c-fms癌蛋白の発現は栄養膜合胞体細胞の細胞質に限局していた。合胞体栄養膜層におけるc-fms蛋白の染色強度は、4種の妊娠組織の間で有意差を認めなかった。c-erbB-2抗体の発現は絨毛外栄養膜細胞の細胞膜に限局していた。正常胎盤や部分胞状奇胎と比較して、c-erbB-2蛋白の発現は完全胞状奇胎(それぞれP < .0001、P < .0001)および絨毛癌(それぞれP < .0001、P < .0001)で有意に強かった。bcl-2蛋白の発現は、完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜で、正常胎盤および部分胞状奇胎の双方と比べて有意に強かった(それぞれP < .0001、P < .0001)。合胞体栄養膜層のc-myc染色は、胎盤、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌で部分胞状奇胎より有意に強かった(それぞれP < .0001、P < .0001、P < .0001)。検討した完全胞状奇胎22例および絨毛癌11例のいずれにもK-ras遺伝子変異は認めなかった。
結論: c-myc、c-erbB-2、c-fms、bcl-2癌蛋白は完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発症に重要である可能性がある。完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌はc-myc、c-erbB-2、bcl-2の過剰発現を特徴とするが、部分胞状奇胎では3つの癌蛋白の強い発現は概して認めなかった。
